notes.title: 141 UPDATE - Ray Tracing : ON
notes.content:
Now, supported NVIDIA GPU cards and DirectX12 can enable real-time ray-tracing in 141.

Installation for the Ray Tracing Version:

- The RTX/HDR version is available only in the Beta branch. 
On the Steam client, right-click 141 on your game list, and select [properties] 

Now click the [BETAS] tab, and you will find the DXR version. That's it!

Hardware requirements:

[list]
[*] 6GB Hard Disk space.
[*] Windows 10 64bit (minimum version 1809)
[*] DirectX12
[/list]

Full ray tracing hardware acceleration is available on the following GPUs:
[list]
[*] NVIDIA GeForce RTX series
[*] NVIDIA Quadro (RTX 3000, RTX 4000, RTX 5000, RTX 6000, RTX 8000)
[/list]

Software acceleration ray tracing (With Latest Game Ready Drivers) :
[list]
[*] NVIDIA GeForce GTX (1650,1660, GTX 1660, 1060, 1070, 1080),
[*] NVIDIA TITAN V
[*] NVIDIA Quadro (P4000, P5000, P6000, V100)
[/list]

FAQ:

 Q: My GPU does not support Ray Tracing, but my PC meets all the requirements (Windows 10 64, DX12). Should I install this branch?

A: If you have DX12, this branch also includes awesome high fidelity shaders that improve overall graphics quality and visuals.
You will notice better reflections, lightning, and detail, with 3 levels of graphics quality.
If your GPU is not on the list, you can still run this version but should not enable Ray Tracing in settings. 
Enabling Ray Tracing with unsupported GPUs is liable to result in graphical errors and subpar performance.

Q: Is the DX11 version going to be abandoned?

A: No, this update also improves performance and unlocks Vsync. It was able to run 144fps on a midrange GPU (Nvidia Geforce 1660 / 144hz display Vsync/ 1920x1080 ).

notes.title: PREPARE FOR DEPLOYMENT
notes.content:
[h2]Mission Mode[/h2]

While shooting and getting shot at in equal measure is all well and good, sometimes you just want to go wild and show off like the badass you are.
If it's starting to feel tiresome to have other players play tug of war with your KDR, let your frustration out in the brand new offline Mission Mode!

Infiltrate any map and singlehandedly battle it out against a horde of bots, all of whom are out for your blood.
Your performance is tracked, the higher the difficulty you choose, the higher the rank you get. 
A three-star rating looks good on any merc's resume!

Even better, any experience you earn is hard-saved onto your character, meaning your progress can be carried over to multiplayer. No battle is wasted!

While you're there, maybe you'd like to try out the new toys we've got in stock:

[h2]Killstreaks[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] Pet Drone
[/list][/h3]

If you're starting to feel a bit paranoid about the escalating mound of bodies lining up behind you, you're probably gonna want one more gun watching your back. 
Once you reach 7 kills in a row, your pet drone will become available as your back up, firing on anyone who gets in your way. 
Handy when you feel that you need just a few more bullets to amp up your rampage. 
Besides, they're a good company!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1140110/extras/movie00bot.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
[*] Radar
[/list][/h3]

For the practical man rather than the show-off, it does what it says on the tin. 
8 kills, and you get the exact, real-time location of all your enemies. 
Simple and sweet.


[h3][list]
[*] Air Strike
[/list][/h3]

There are two ways to take out a target. You line up a shot and hit it, or you line up a general area and wait to hit whatever unlucky thing happens to wander in front of your barrage. 
If you manage to reach 10 kills, your well-earned reward is a salvo of missiles that rain down hell over a wide zone, meaning near to no escape to anyone caught in the crossfire. 
Keep yourself at a safe distance, but not so safe that you'd miss the fire show.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1140110/extras/movie002.gif[/img]

-----------------------------------------------

[h2]LET'S GET SOCIAL[/h2]


Discord and Twitch integration have now been properly introduced to 141! 
From the options menu, you can enable awesome tools like server notifications and twitch chat commands that allow your audience to actively interact with the match.

By default, the discord plugin will send messages and events to the official 141 discord server.
In the settings menu, the server can be changed to a custom address using a discord channel webhook (channel settings>webhook).
A custom nickname and avatar can also be used.

With Twitch integration, you can watch your stream chat in real-time during gameplay, and let your viewers cheer for their favorite teams. 
Using a poll system, you can also set up custom polls and let your viewers choose maps. characters, weapon MODs to grab, and whatever else you can think of.

notes.title: UPDATE: AN EYE FOR AN EYE
notes.content:
Two men, five rounds, one arena. Test your skills in one on one combat and use your intuition and sharpshooting skills to outsmart and outgun your enemy. Duel Mode is here!

[h3]New Game Mode Duel[/h3]
You'll be placed in a map matched against a single player. Scour the battlefield for MODs and lay low like a guerilla fighter while you look for any leverage against your opponent, or scout the terrain and snipe from vantage points, patiently waiting until your target shows their head. Observe, think and strategize. First to beat five rounds wins in the purest way to prove your superior combat skills.

notes.title: UPDATE: Carnage In Style
notes.content:
Why settle for destroying your enemies when you can demolish the ground you walk on, too? This update, besides featuring a lot of fixes and patches, also introduces destructible objects and terrain.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1140110/extras/movie005.gif[/img]

Firefights are about to get a whole lot messier. Now when you're trading shots with your competitors, chances are your surroundings are going to be a smoldering wreck by the time you're done. If your opponent's bodies aren't proof enough of your skill, the destruction you leave behind should be.
